author: poisenbery
quote:
This "game" has been utterly stripped of the core identity of the Grand Theft Auto franchise. 
This is not a crime simulation game, this is a simp boyfriend simulator.
You bend over backwards trying to make Lucia happy, but when you play as her, there is absolutely ZERO reciprocation of the effort Jason puts on her.

It was obviously written by people who have never been in a healthy relationship in their lives.

Don't waste your money on this game, play GTA V with mods instead.

I'm hoping the PC release modders fix this horrible mess. I feel scammed and I want my money back.
